name: Business Academy Aarhus
about: Business Academy Aarhus is a practice-oriented business academy in Viby, south of Aarhus. Its English first-year option is Multimedia Design, a two-year AP combining web and interface design, front-end programming and a company internship. The academy emphasises small classes, group projects and work with companies.

languageOfInstruction.note: Multimedia Design is the English first-year AP. Digital Concept Development requires prior higher education and has its final intake in August 2027; it is not a progression route for AP entrants in 2027.

notes: AP entrants from August 2026 onward cannot continue to the existing 18-month bachelor top-ups. Digital Concept Development’s last intake is August 2027; a replacement bachelor route for the 2027 AP cohort is not confirmed.

Submit your latest transcript, BAAA’s school-signed verification form and photo ID with the application. The final diploma follows receipt under admissions instructions; confirm how May 2027 IB results meet the stated 5 July exam-completion rule.

Tuition exemptions include EU/EEA citizenship and specified Danish residence permits. Other students pay EUR 6,000 per semester under the schedule valid from 2026. Positive institutional accreditation runs through 30 September 2027.
